name: GitHub
diffReason: Easy: registering an OAuth app is self-serve, and review applies only to an optional GitHub Marketplace listing

steps.t: Pick OAuth App or GitHub App
steps.d: GitHub Apps get fine-grained permissions and GitHub generally prefers them; OAuth Apps act only on behalf of the user.
Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps → New OAuth App. Enter the application name, homepage URL and callback URL.
Paste your redirect URI, e.g. https://yourapp.com/api/auth/callback/github. You can add up to 10.
On the app's settings page, click Generate a new client secret, then store it as an env var.

blockers.s: Organizations with OAuth app access restrictions must approve your app before it can reach their private data.

agent: Draft app name, homepage and description
Generate the correct callback URL for your stack
Check your scopes are the minimum needed
you: Generate and store the client secret
Ask org admins to approve, if restricted
sources: Differences between GitHub Apps and OAuth apps
